_comment: Word Ladder start/target pairs. The browser owns the dictionary and the solver, so the model is asked for themed, printable end words plus a suggested chain; anything it gets structurally wrong is repaired client-side.
varietyHints: favour the most typical everyday examples first
pair two words a reader would enjoy seeing joined (cold to warm, head to tail)
favour concrete nouns over abstract ideas
vary the opening letter across the list
lean toward words an older adult would know from daily life
include a few pairs that read as opposites
vary across different parts or moments of the theme
prefer plain single words over specialised jargon
